overview: Top Model. Zostań modelką is an ongoing reality documentary based on Tyra Banks' America's Next Top Model that pits contestants from Poland against each other in a variety of competitions to determine who will win the title of the next Polish Top Model and a lucrative modeling contract with NEXT agency as well as an appearance on the cover of the Polish issue of Glamour and a nationwide Max Factor campaign in hopes of a successful future in the modeling business.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
Top Model. Zostań modelką, Cycle 1 is the first Cycle of an ongoing reality documentary based on Tyra Banks' America's Next Top Model that pits contestants from Poland against each other in a variety of competitions to determine who will win the title of the next Polish Top Model and a lucrative modeling contract with NEXT Model Management as well as an appearance on the cover of the Polish issue of Glamour and a nationwide Max Factor campaign in hopes of a successful future in the modeling business.

The competition is hosted by Polish born supermodel Joanna Krupa who serves as the lead judge alongside fashion designer Dawid Woliński, journalist Karolina Korwin-Piotrowska and photographer Marcin Tyszka. It has also been confirmed that international topmodels Anja Rubik and Magdalena Mielcarz will make guest appearances and coaching the contestants in some episodes.

Paulina Papierska, a 19-year-old woman from a little town named Zbąszynek won the competition. On the show she was criticized for her inability to speak English.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview:
Top Model. Zostań modelką, Cycle 2 is the second Cycle of an ongoing reality documentary based on Tyra Banks' America's Next Top Model that pits contestants from Poland against each other in a variety of competitions to determine who will win the title of the next Polish Top Model and a lucrative modeling contract with NEXT Model Management as well as an appearance on the cover of the Polish issue of Glamour and a nationwide Max Factor campaign in hopes of a successful future in the modeling business.

The first destination this cycle was Paris, France. The second international destination was set in Mombasa, Kenya.

The winner of the competition was 19 year-old Olga Kaczyńska from Wroclaw. After the airing of the show, there were controversies that Olga's participation in the competition was unfair, because she had allegedly been a professional model since 2006.

The competition was hosted by Polish born supermodel Joanna Krupa who served as the lead judge alongside fashion designer Dawid Woliński, journalist Karolina Korwin-Piotrowska and photographer Marcin Tyszka.

The first destination this cycle was Mumbai, India. The second international destination was set in Madeira, Portugal.

The winner of the competition was 20 year-old Zuzanna Kołodziejczyk from Poznań.

The competition was hosted by Polish born supermodel Joanna Krupa who served as the lead judge alongside fashion designer Dawid Woliński, fashion show director Katarzyna Sokołowska and photographer Marcin Tyszka
